# Transition II: The Age of Aspiration

The summer of 1963 arrived in northern Michigan with the particular laziness of seasons in a place where the year still divided cleanly into two halves: the months of mud and the months of warmth. Bob was eleven years old, and the world was starting to make demands on him that it had not made before. High school was four years away.
